scope: Phase 1 constrained skeleton + two-bone IK (master plan §5, §9.1, §9.6). Runner rig, 94 frames @ 1920x1080.

conventions.coordinates: canvas pixels, y down, character faces +x
conventions.bendSign: sign of cross(root->target, root->mid); knees -1 (front), elbows +1 (trailing); mirroring flips x and the sign
conventions.annulusClamp: [|l1-l2|+EPS, l1+l2-EPS], EPS=0.000001; end = point actually reached; residual = |target-end|
conventions.foot: ankle->toe is foot artwork geometry (constant length), NOT a constrained bone

calibration.method: rig.ts header: legs = max measured hip->ankle span + 0.5 px reach margin, thigh/calf split by least-squares knee fit over the 14 raw poses (0.25 px scan); arms = mean of the two extreme upper-arm readings + the reliable near-straight back forearm reading; foot = median of 14 ankle->toe readings. Reproducible via calibrateRunnerRig(); asserted by test/rig.test.ts.

solverCases.detail: exact lengths, end == target, bend side honored
EPS margin keeps near-straight solve non-degenerate
clamped onto the reach ray; residual reported, never hidden
folded safely at the inner annulus boundary

solverCases.detail: rig errors fail loudly, never render NaN

solverCases.case: seeded random sweep (500 targets, both signs)
solverCases.detail: fixed lengths + stable bend side for arbitrary reachable/unreachable targets

solverCases.case: mirrored limb solve through the shared evaluator path (frame 34)
solverCases.detail: solveLimb mirrors exactly with flipped hint

midDeviationFromRawTargets.note: Expected nonzero: raw knee/elbow readings are noisy hand measurements. The solver prioritizes end-effector accuracy + fixed bone lengths. Reported per frame below — never hidden.

gates.gate: every constrained bone within ±0.5 px of configured length (94 frames × 8 bones)
reachable end-effector residual ≤ 1 px; clamping reported
bend side constant and equal to rig hint on every frame (incl. 25->26 wrap)
foot artwork length constant (geometry, not a bone)
all named solver edge cases pass

historicalBaseline.note: The ratio gate is replaced by the per-bone configured-length gate above (master plan §9.7). Raw-track variation remains reported as a diagnostic in reports/motion-validation.json.
